meta.title: Lunch at the Museum Corner
meta.textType: a menu with pictures and prices

paragraphs: I am Mia, and I am ten years old. On Sunday, my dad takes Leo and me to the museum. The museum is big, and it has many old bicycles. Dad fixes bikes, so he likes them the most. After the museum, we have lunch at a cafe on the corner. Leo is quiet, and he does not smile. "I have a toothache," he says. "Then we choose soft food," says Dad. "Which food is best for you, Leo?" asks Dad. A menu with pictures is on the table.

I read the menu to Leo. Vegetable soup is forty baht. An egg sandwich is thirty-five baht. A fruit salad is forty-five baht. A piece of chocolate cake is forty baht. Milk is twenty-five baht, and apple juice is twenty-five baht too. The cook prepares everything in the small kitchen. We can see him through a window. The cafe is small, and it has six tables.

"The soup comes in a deep bowl," I say. "It is warm and soft, so it is good for your tooth." "I don't want the cake," says Leo. "It is sweet, and my tooth hurts." Dad wants a sandwich and a glass of milk. I want a piece of cake, and I need a knife and a fork. Dad laughs and says, "Cut it small!"

I write a note for the cook. "Leo: vegetable soup and milk. Dad: sandwich and milk. Mia: cake and apple juice." The cook reads it and smiles at us. Leo eats his soup slowly, and he feels better. "Thank you, Mia," he says. "The menu helps me a lot."
text.summary: Mia, Leo, and Mia's dad have lunch at a cafe on the corner next to the museum. Leo has a toothache, so Mia reads the menu with him and writes a note for the cook.
